title: Open-weight AI models take majority of Vercel traffic
key_facts: Vercel's September AI Gateway Production Index says open-weight models made up 56% of token volume on its AI Gateway in August, up from 13% in April and 7% in December 2025; August was the first month with a majority.
The data is anonymised aggregate traffic through Vercel's AI Gateway, which moves tens of trillions of tokens a month; spending is estimated from published list prices.
The average price per token fell 23.2% in August, the third straight monthly decline and the steepest since April 2026; the average token costs less than half what it did five months earlier.
Open-weight models were only 14% of gateway spending in August, so higher-priced closed models still took most of the money.
Anthropic held 64% of gateway spend in August and has taken at least 61 cents of each dollar every month since December.
Half of August's tokens went to models available for less than three months.
Anthropic's Fable 5 fell from 13.2% to 4.9% of gateway spend between July and August while Opus 5, at roughly half the price per token, rose to 22.5%.
OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra reached one in every three dollars spent on OpenAI models through the gateway within two days of launch.
quote_evidence: According to Vercel's September AI Gateway Production Index, open-weight models accounted for 56% of token volume in August, up from 13% in April and 7% in December 2025.
While open-weight models accounted for most token volume, they represented a much smaller share of spending.
Anthropic held 64% of gateway spend in August.
why_it_matters_hint: Free-to-download models now carry most of the text traffic on one large developer service while paid closed models still take most of the money.
event_date: Data covers August 2026; the Vercel index is called the September index. The publication date of the index is not stated; IT Brief Asia published on 2 Oct 2026.
notes: Read in full from the main session's fetch (HTTP 200). Figures describe one company's gateway, not the whole market. Token counts and spend are Vercel's estimates.
